frozen_rule_sensitivity.interpretation: Frozen analysis retains candidate failures and excludes preregistered infrastructure-invalid attempts; successful-only results are a labeled, non-preregistered sensitivity check.

generated_from.input_token_semantics: input_tokens includes cached_input_tokens; cached input is not added again

paired_bootstrap.method: deterministic nonparametric percentile bootstrap of paired-block means

power.analytic_method: Monotone closed-form two-sided known-SD z-test power using NormalDist.cdf; analytic minima drive the decision.
limits: The ten-block pilot residual SD has only the reported residual degrees of freedom and is uncertain.
Known-SD z power assumes independent normal order-residual log ratios and is a planning approximation.
